item: {{attacker}} throws a wild punch that barely clips {{defender}}.
kept: {{attacker}} throws a wild punch that only clips {{defender}}'s shoulder.

item: The sheer force of the blow sends {{name}} tumbling to the sands.
kept: The sheer force of the blow sends {{name}} sprawling onto the arena sand.

item: {{attacker}} delivers a cold, clinical finishing blow, ending {{defender}}'s struggles.
kept: {{attacker}} delivers a cold, clinical finishing blow, ending {{defender}}'s life without hesitation.

pbp.attacks.piercing: {{attacker}} darts like a viper, sinking {{possessive}} {{weapon}} in a vicious, penetrating lunge.
With a fencer's cruel precision, {{attacker}} threads the needle, aiming a lethal thrust at {{defender}}.
{{attacker}} extends fully, channeling their entire body weight into a pinpoint strike with {{possessive}} {{weapon}}.
A blindingly fast jab from {{attacker}} threatens to skewer {{defender}} where they stand.
pbp.attacks.slashing: {{attacker}} arcs {{possessive}} {{weapon}} in a sudden, blinding crescent toward {{defender}}'s throat.
With a savage roar, {{attacker}} sweeps {{possessive}} {{weapon}} in a wide, decapitating slash.
{{attacker}} feints a thrust before snapping {{possessive}} wrists into a blistering horizontal cut.
The edge of {{attacker}}'s {{weapon}} whistles a deadly tune as it cleaves the air toward {{defender}}.
pbp.attacks.bashing: {{attacker}} heaves {{possessive}} {{weapon}} with the force of a collapsing mountain, aiming to crush {{defender}}.
Grunting with exertion, {{attacker}} swings {{possessive}} {{weapon}} in a bone-shattering arc.
{{attacker}} drives their {{weapon}} forward like a battering ram, intent on shattering {{defender}}'s guard.
With unrelenting brutality, {{attacker}} hammers down with {{possessive}} {{weapon}}.
pbp.attacks.fist: {{attacker}} steps inside {{defender}}'s guard, unleashing a piston-like straight punch.
With raw, bare-knuckle savagery, {{attacker}} throws a crushing overhand right.
{{attacker}} drops their shoulder and rips a brutal uppercut aimed at {{defender}}'s jaw.
A flurry of heavy, unprotected blows rains down as {{attacker}} swarms {{defender}}.
pbp.defenses.dodge.desperate: Eyes wide with terror, {{defender}} flings themselves backward, barely escaping the lethal blow.
{{defender}} scrambles wildly in the dirt, rolling just in time to avoid decapitation.
With a breathless gasp, {{defender}} contorts their body, the weapon whistling mere inches from their skin.
pbp.defenses.dodge.confident: {{defender}} sidesteps with a dismissive smirk, letting the attack sail harmlessly past.
Moving with liquid grace, {{defender}} sways just out of reach, completely unbothered.
{{defender}} barely shifts their weight, reading the attack perfectly and dodging with arrogant ease.
pbp.defenses.dodge.theatrical: {{defender}} executes a flawless, sweeping backflip, dodging the attack to the roar of the crowd.
With a mocking bow, {{defender}} twirls out of the weapon's path, treating the fight like a dance.
{{defender}} dramatically drops into a low crouch, the lethal strike passing over their head as they play to the stands.
pbp.defenses.dodge.grim: {{defender}} shifts just enough to survive, their face a mask of cold, silent endurance.
With a sharp, necessary flinch, {{defender}} narrowly avoids the blow, their eyes never leaving {{attacker}}.
A bleak, mechanical dodge sees {{defender}} evade the strike, showing no emotion but the will to survive.
pbp.defenses.parry.desperate: {{defender}} frantically throws up their guard, the jarring impact nearly dislocating their shoulder.
With a panicked cry, {{defender}} barely manages to intercept the blow, stumbling backward.
{{defender}}'s weapon trembles violently as they barely deflect the crushing strike.
pbp.defenses.parry.confident: {{defender}} swats the attack aside with disdain, completely unfazed by the assault.
A sharp, practiced flick of the wrist from {{defender}} effortlessly turns the deadly strike away.
{{defender}} meets the blow head-on, their guard an unbreakable wall of steel.
pbp.defenses.parry.theatrical: {{defender}} deflects the blow with a flourishing spin, winking at the crowd as sparks fly.
With a dramatic clash of steel, {{defender}} parries the strike and strikes a heroic pose.
{{defender}} catches the blow on their guard with a loud, ringing clash, turning it into a spectacle.
pbp.defenses.parry.grim: {{defender}} mechanically intercepts the strike, the brutal vibration echoing their grim reality.
A cold, hard parry from {{defender}}, sacrificing the edge of their weapon to survive the exchange.
{{defender}} meets the blow with a stoic block, their expression entirely dead to the violence.
pbp.defenses.riposte.desperate: Stumbling from the block, {{defender}} lashes out blindly in a panicked counter-strike.
{{defender}} frantically shoves the attack away and stabs wildly, desperate for breathing room.
pbp.defenses.riposte.confident: {{defender}} smoothly redirects the attack and instantly snaps back a masterclass counter.
Having baited the strike, {{defender}} parries easily and delivers a punishing, arrogant riposte.
pbp.defenses.riposte.theatrical: {{defender}} deflects the blow and immediately counters with a flashy, crowd-pleasing flourish.
With a sweeping motion, {{defender}} turns the parry into a dramatic, spinning counter-attack.
pbp.defenses.riposte.grim: {{defender}} absorbs the shock and ruthlessly steps into a bleak, punishing counter-blow.
A mechanical block is followed instantly by a cold, calculating strike from {{defender}}.
pbp.knockdown.fall: The sheer force of the blow sweeps {{name}} off their feet, crashing heavily into the bloody sands.
{{name}} crumples like a puppet with cut strings, collapsing into a heap on the arena floor.
A sickening thud echoes as {{name}} is blasted backward, sprawling awkwardly in the dirt.
pbp.knockdown.recovery: Coughing up dust and blood, {{name}} agonizingly drags themselves back to a standing position.
{{name}} springs back up with terrifying speed, ignoring the pain to re-enter the fray.
Leaning heavily on their weapon, {{name}} staggers upright, swaying but unbowed.
kill_text.execution: {{attacker}} steps past the mangled guard of {{defender}}, delivering a bleak, calculated execution that freezes the crowd.
With a chilling lack of emotion, {{attacker}} slides their weapon into {{defender}}'s heart, ending the misery.
The crowd goes dead silent as {{attacker}} calmly severs {{defender}}'s life thread with a single, surgical strike.
